findings.problem: In the inductive `mul` step, both the coprime-to-3 branch (lines 282-291) and the ramified branch (lines 304-309) reason the same way. Each first proves `cubicSymbol a (p*u) = cubicSymbol b (p*u)` for a unit `u`. It then splits off the unit with `cubicSymbol_mul_upper`, rewrites the unit factor with `cubicSymbol_unit_periodic ... h9`, and cancels it with `mul_right_cancel₀`. That cancellation needs `cubicSymbol b u ≠ 0`, which each branch proves again with the same four-line norm argument (`norm_cubicSymbol_of_isCoprime`, `rw [hz,norm_zero]`, `norm_num`). `symbol_three_aux` (lines 35-39) repeats that nonvanishing argument a third time. The mathematical point, that periodicity at `p*u` gives periodicity at `p` once units are known to be periodic, is never stated on its own.
findings.proposed_change:
Add two lemmas after `unit_coprime_right` (line 224):

```lean
private lemma cubicSymbol_ne_zero_of_isCoprime {b v : Eisenstein} (hb : primary b)
    (hv : IsCoprime b v) : cubicSymbol b v ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have hh := norm_cubicSymbol_of_isCoprime hb hv
  rw [hz, norm_zero] at hh
  norm_num at hh

/-- Periodicity at `p * u` for a unit `u` descends to periodicity at `p`. -/
private lemma cubicSymbol_eq_of_eq_mul_unit {a b p u : Eisenstein}
    (ha : primary a) (hb : primary b) (hu : IsUnit u) (h9 : (9 : Eisenstein) ∣ a-b)
    (h : cubicSymbol a (p*u) = cubicSymbol b (p*u)) : cubicSymbol a p = cubicSymbol b p := by
  rw [cubicSymbol_mul_upper ha, cubicSymbol_mul_upper hb,
    cubicSymbol_unit_periodic ha hb hu h9] at h
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (cubicSymbol_ne_zero_of_isCoprime hb (unit_coprime_right b hu)) h
```

The first lemma only needs `norm_cubicSymbol_of_isCoprime`, so it could go before `symbol_three_aux`, or in `SquarefreeGauss.lean`. In `symbol_three_aux`, `hn` then becomes `cubicSymbol_ne_zero_of_isCoprime hr hrx`.

The coprime branch becomes:
```lean
· obtain ⟨u,hu,hprim⟩ := unit_lift_mod_three (residue_isUnit_of_isCoprime hp3.symm)
  have hpv : p ∣ a-b := (dvd_mul_right p v).trans ((dvd_mul_left (p*v) 9).trans hab)
  have hpu : p*u ∣ a-b := (associated_mul_unit_right p u hu).dvd_iff_dvd_left.mp hpv
  have heq := cubicSymbol_congr (b := p*u) (residue_eq_of_dvd_sub hpu)
  rw [← cubic_reciprocity ha hprim, ← cubic_reciprocity hb hprim] at heq
  exact cubicSymbol_eq_of_eq_mul_unit ha hb hu h9 heq
```

After `obtain ⟨u,hu⟩ := hpunit`, the ramified branch ends with:
```lean
  exact cubicSymbol_eq_of_eq_mul_unit ha hb u.isUnit h9
    (by simpa only [hu] using cubicSymbol_lambda_periodic ha hb h9)
```
This removes `hunit`, `he`, and the two inline norm arguments.
findings.benefit: Each branch then shows only what is specific to it: reciprocity against a primary associate in one case, the λ-supplement in the other. The shared unit-cancellation step gets a name and a statement. The nonvanishing fact, currently written out three times in this file and again in `CubicThetaKubotaProduct.lean`, lives in one lemma, so a change to `cubicSymbol_mul_upper` or the norm API needs fixing in one place. The `mul` case gets shorter, and the induction is easier to compare with the argument in the paper.
